# CoreFlow

> CoreFlow is a European service company that delivers liquid cooling for AI data centers from design to maintenance: the full loop between the facility water and the racks, CDUs included, with a single partner accountable end to end.

Key facts: CoreFlow is a service team, not a product vendor, and is independent of cooling manufacturers. It designs or reviews the liquid cooling loop in 3D BIM, supplies and installs CDUs, stainless pipework, insulation, pre-assembled manifolds and sensors, flushes, pressure-tests and commissions the loop, hands over a full quality dossier (joint-by-joint traceability, test reports, as-built drawings), then monitors and maintains the loop for the life of the system. The primary loop is an optional part of the scope. Customers: AI clouds, enterprise data centers, and cooling manufacturers who need a local second line for maintenance. CoreFlow was founded in 2026 by Benjamin Charbit, is based in Paris, France, and works across Europe. Contact: contact@coreflowdc.com.
